about: g7_run.py inputs (MV2, Munim, Inc.; made with AI agents; CC BY 4.0). Step g7, registered in findings/2026-11-24-g7-prereg.md; ephemerides as amended in findings/2026-11-24-g7-amendment-1.md (written before any Gaia DR4 data exist). Times in BTJD (BJD_TDB - 2457000). P, e, omega fix the orbit's shape (e, omega are Gaia DR3's, component 1); t_conj is an eclipse time near the middle of the DR4 time span where possible; eph_sigma is the ephemeris uncertainty at the DR4 epochs. Controls: published linear ephemerides (Min I), eph_sigma = max(0.001 d, propagated error). Targets: fallback values by the amended rule; on DR4 day they are replaced by sb2-new-ebs-timing-v1's ephemeris if that job ended CONTROLS_OK. inc / inc_err come from sb2-ebfit-v1 if it ended CONTROLS_OK, else stay FILL (minimum masses only). K priors only seed the component assignment.
